messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — new org-wide policy: we're moving all internal services from broad long-lived service accounts to scoped delegation tokens (short-lived OAuth2 client credentials). This affects any infra that assumes the 'global-service' role. Rollout starts 2026-04-01 and will be phased over two weeks. Please read below for required actions and timeline.

alina: What's the immediate action for apps in our dev sandbox?

mira: For sandbox apps: create a scoped delegation client via the token-refactorer tool and replace the SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAME env var with DELEGATION_CLIENT_ID/SECRET. You'll get a 1h token by default. Example:

```bash
# create scoped client for read-only storage access
token-refactorer create --name myapp-readonly --scopes storage:read --project infra-sandbox
export DELEGATION_CLIENT_ID=rc_abc123
export DELEGATION_CLIENT_SECRET=redacted
```

mira: We'll surface a migration report in the console for each project and automatically create PRs for simple swaps. If you need a longer TTL for batch jobs, request approval in the migration form (link below).

paul: CI pipelines use service accounts to publish artifacts — do we need to change every pipeline manually?

ken: Short answer: mostly no. devops-oncall and I will run an automation that updates common ci templates for supported runners (github actions + koios-runner). Custom runners will need manual updates. We'll post the list of updated repos.

devops-oncall: Automation schedule:
- 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC: run dry-run across all repos, open PRs with suggested token changes.
- 2026-04-02 04:00 UTC: apply changes to repos that passed dry-run.
- 2026-04-08: start enforcing token introspection in runtimes (fail-fast on broad service account usage).

alina: Where's the migration form?

mira: migration form + FAQ: https://intranet.redwood/eng/security/scoped-delegation-migration (has approval flow, TTL policy, and example config). If you need exception for legacy infra, request via the form with owner and risk mitigation.

security-bot: Automated checklist generated for project infra-sandbox: [ ] created scoped clients: 2/5, [ ] CI PRs opened: 7, [ ] runtime introspection enabled: NO. See dashboard: https://console.redwood/migrations/infra-sandbox

paul: We'll opt-in to the automation for our monorepo. One ask: keep a fallback path for a short window if a token swap breaks deploys (grace period).

mira: Agreed — 48h graceful fallback policy. We'll also keep a read-only audit log of any fallback usage.

ken: Ping me or @devops-oncall with repo names you want excluded from automation.

alina: Thanks — will start onboarding my team tomorrow. :thumbsup:

mira: Thanks all. If you hit any blocker, drop it here or DM me. This reduces blast radius and lets us enforce least privilege consistently. :lock:
